tailored:
Dear iwoca hiring team,

I'm applying for the Full-stack Engineer role on your Operations Engineering Team. What draws me to iwoca specifically is the Operations Engineering setup: a small cross-functional team building internal tools like your CRM for 70+ colleagues, where an engineer owns a problem from stakeholder conversation to delivery. That end-to-end shape is exactly how I like to work.

I've built full-stack systems that mirror this kind of work. For TalentHiv, an AI-driven candidate screening platform, I built the REST backend in FastAPI with routes, services, models and schemas, designed the PostgreSQL database with SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations, implemented GDPR features (data export and deletion), and deployed to Azure App Service with Key Vault alongside a Next.js/React/TypeScript frontend. For VoiceHive Hotels I built a multilingual AI voice receptionist on FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Docker/Kubernetes, integrating Azure OpenAI for context-aware conversation handling.

I use AI tools daily in my development flow, and I bring 20 years leading operational teams of 50+ at Casino Cosmopol in a regulated environment — so I understand the workflows internal operations teams actually depend on, not just how to code for them.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to the team.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
